    payload = case.get("payload") if "payload" in case else case
    
    nodes_list = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes_list:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing required field: {field}")
    
    # Build data structures
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes_list}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes_list}
    
    # Find root
    root_id = None
    for n in nodes_list:
        if n["parent"] is None:
            if root_id is not None:
                raise ValueError("Multiple root nodes found")
            root_id = n["id"]
        else:
            if n["parent"] not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    if root_id is None:
        raise ValueError("No root node found")
    
    # Track retained nodes
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    
    # Build symbol -> set of node IDs mapping
    symbol_nodes = {}
    for n in nodes_list:
        sym = n["symbol"]
        if sym not in symbol_nodes:
            symbol_nodes[sym] = set()
        symbol_nodes[sym].add(n["id"])
    
    # Validate required symbols are present
    for sym in required_symbols:
        if sym not in symbol_nodes:
            raise ValueError(f"Required symbol {sym} not found in any node")
    
    # Sort candidates: deepest first, then by node ID lexicographically
    candidates = sorted(
        nodes_list,
        key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"])
    )
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if already removed (shouldn't happen but defensive)
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        
        # Check: no retained children
        has_retained_children = any(c in retained for c in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Check: after removal, all required symbols still represented
        can_remove = True
        sym = node["symbol"]
        if sym in required_symbols:
            # Count retained nodes with this symbol (excluding current)

            if count == 0:
                can_remove = False
        
        if not can_remove:
            continue
        
        # Remove the node
        retained.remove(nid)
        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }

    payload = case["payload"]
    nodes_list = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields in each node
    required_node_fields = {"id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"}
    for node in nodes_list:
        missing = required_node_fields - set(node.keys())
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"Node missing fields: {missing}")
    
    # Build id -> node mapping
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes_list}
    
    # Build children mapping
    children = {nid: [] for nid in nodes}
    root_id = None
    for n in nodes_list:
        if n["parent"] is None:
            if root_id is not None:
                raise ValueError("Multiple root nodes")
            root_id = n["id"]
        else:
            parent = n["parent"]
            if parent not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown parent {parent!r} for node {n['id']!r}")
            children[parent].append(n["id"])
    
    if root_id is None:
        raise ValueError("No root node found")
    
    # Build symbol -> node ids mapping
    symbol_to_nodes = {}
    for n in nodes_list:
        sym = n["symbol"]
        if sym not in symbol_to_nodes:
            symbol_to_nodes[sym] = []
        symbol_to_nodes[sym].append(n["id"])
    
    # Validate all required symbols present
    for sym in required_symbols:
        if sym not in symbol_to_nodes:
            raise ValueError(f"Required symbol {sym!r} absent from tree")
    
    # Process candidates: deepest first, then lexicographic node ID
    candidates = sorted(nodes_list, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        if not node["removable"]:

        # Must have no retained children

        # After removal, required symbols must still be covered

        retained.discard(nid)
        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
